blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS—As many as 1,500 workers in various infrastructure projects of the provincial government will get daily health breaks during the hottest hours of the day to prevent heatstroke and other ailments amid the Super El Niño. Bulacan Provincial Engineer Glen Reyes has advised all building contractors with ongoing projects to adjust working hours and provide every construction worker one or two-hour breaks. “They can work full time on hours of the day when the temperature is not at peak heat and rest when the heat is at its sharpest.
